def DrawGlyph(g, cell=150, pad=14):
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    im = Image.new("L", (cell, cell), 255)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    strokes = g.get("strokes") or []
    pts = [p for s in strokes for p in s]
    if not pts:
        return im
    xs = [p[0] for p in pts]
    ys = [p[1] for p in pts]
    w = max(1e-6, max(xs)-min(xs))
    h = max(1e-6, max(ys)-min(ys))
    k = (cell-2*pad)/max(w, h)
    ox = (cell-w*k)/2.0
    oy = (cell-h*k)/2.0
    for s in strokes:
        q = [(ox+(p[0]-min(xs))*k, cell-(oy+(p[1]-min(ys))*k)) for p in s]
        if len(q) > 1:
            d.line(q, fill=0, width=2)
    return im

def Sheet(writer, curated=False, cell=150):
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    prof, path = LoadProfile(writer, curated)
    glyphs = prof.get("glyphs") or {}
    outDir = OUT/writer
    outDir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    made = []
    for ch in sorted(glyphs):
        vs = glyphs[ch]
        cols = min(10, max(1, len(vs)))
        rows = (len(vs)+cols-1)//cols
        im = Image.new("L", (cols*cell, rows*(cell+22)+26), 255)
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
        d.text((6, 6), "%s  %r  %d variants" % (writer, ch, len(vs)), fill=0)
        for i, g in enumerate(vs):
            cx, cy = (i % cols)*cell, 26+(i//cols)*(cell+22)
            im.paste(DrawGlyph(g, cell), (cx, cy))
            tag = "%d%s" % (i, "  proto" if g.get("denoised") else "")
            d.text((cx+4, cy+cell+4), tag, fill=0)
            d.text((cx+4, cy+cell+12), "pd %.2f" % float(g.get("priorD", 0.5)), fill=0)
        safe = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "_%02x" % ord(c) for c in ch)
        f = outDir/("%s.png" % safe)
        im.save(f)
        made.append((ch, len(vs), f.name))
    index = outDir/"INDEX.txt"
    with open(index, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("%s, from %s\n\n" % (writer, path.name))
        fh.write("the number under a variant is its index, for --drop and --keep\n")
        fh.write("pd is the prior distance: lower means closer to the usual shape\n\n")
        for ch, n, name in made:
            fh.write("%-4r %3d variants  %s\n" % (ch, n, name))
    print("wrote %d character sheets to %s" % (len(made), outDir))
    print("  index: %s" % index)
    return made
inventory.comment: Sheet: one image per character, every variant numbered the number under a variant is its index, which is what drop and keep take.  a variant marked proto is the denoised prototype the builder prepended rather than one the writer actually wrote

inventory.name: Medoid
inventory.source:
def Medoid(ch, vs):
    grids = [(ST._ShapeGrid(g), g) for g in vs]
    grids = [(v, g) for v, g in grids if v is not None]
    if len(grids) < 2:
        return None
    G = np.stack([v for v, _ in grids])
    D = np.abs(G[:, None, :]-G[None, :, :]).sum(-1)
    med = grids[int(np.argmin(D.sum(1)))][1]
    return dict(strokes=[ST.SmoothStroke(s) for s in med["strokes"]],
                priorD=round(float(med.get("priorD", 0.5)), 4),
                advance=round(float(med.get("advance", 0.9)), 3),
                lead=round(float(med.get("lead", 0.0)), 3),
                width=round(float(med.get("width", 0.9)), 3),
                top=round(float(med.get("top", 1.0)), 3),
                bot=round(float(med.get("bot", 0.0)), 3),
                entryY=round(float(med.get("entryY", 0.3)), 3),
                exitY=round(float(med.get("exitY", 0.3)), 3),
                nPool=len(vs))

def Prototype(ch, vs):
    proto = ST._DenoisedPrototype(vs)
    if proto is None:
        return None
    pts = [p for s in proto for p in s]
    xs = [p[0] for p in pts]
    ys = [p[1] for p in pts]
    return dict(strokes=[ST.SmoothStroke(s) for s in proto],
                priorD=round(float(np.median([g.get("priorD", 0.5) for g in vs])), 4),
                advance=round(float(np.median([g["advance"] for g in vs])), 3),
                lead=round(float(np.median([g.get("lead", 0.0) for g in vs])), 3),
                width=round(max(xs)-min(xs), 3),
                top=round(max(ys), 3), bot=round(min(ys), 3),
                entryY=round(float(np.median([g.get("entryY", 0.3) for g in vs])), 3),

def Apply(writer, drop=None, keep=None, curated=False, outName=None):
    prof, path = LoadProfile(writer, curated)
    glyphs = dict(prof.get("glyphs") or {})
    drop = {k: set(v) for k, v in (drop or {}).items() if v}
    keep = {k: set(v) for k, v in (keep or {}).items()}
    for ch in list(drop)+list(keep):
        if ch not in glyphs:
            raise SystemExit("%r has no variants in %s" % (ch, path.name))

    removed, emptied = 0, []
    for ch, vs in list(glyphs.items()):
        if ch in keep:
            chosen = [g for i, g in enumerate(vs) if i in keep[ch]]
        elif ch in drop:
            chosen = [g for i, g in enumerate(vs) if i not in drop[ch]]
        else:
            continue
        removed += len(vs)-len(chosen)
        if not chosen:
            emptied.append(ch)
            del glyphs[ch]
        else:
            glyphs[ch] = chosen

    prof["glyphs"] = glyphs
    #the three things the set decides, recomputed from what is left
    ideal = dict(prof.get("idealGlyphs") or {})
    medoid = dict(prof.get("idealMedoid") or {})
    adv = dict(prof.get("letterAdvance") or {})
    touched = set(drop) | set(keep)
    for ch in touched:
        if ch not in glyphs:
            ideal.pop(ch, None)
            medoid.pop(ch, None)
            adv.pop(ch, None)
            continue
        vs = glyphs[ch]
        p = Prototype(ch, vs)
        m = Medoid(ch, vs)
        if p is None:
            ideal.pop(ch, None)
        else:
            ideal[ch] = p
        if m is None:
            medoid.pop(ch, None)
        else:
            medoid[ch] = m
        adv[ch] = round(float(np.median([g["advance"] for g in vs])), 3)
    prof["idealGlyphs"] = ideal
    prof["idealMedoid"] = medoid
    prof["letterAdvance"] = adv
    #connectedness is a ratio over adjacent pairs seen while reading the pages,
    #and which letters sat next to which is not kept, so it cannot be recomputed
    #faithfully here.  it is left alone, and that is recorded in the file
    prof["curatedFrom"] = path.name
    prof["curatedRemoved"] = removed
    prof["curatedNote"] = ("glyphs, idealGlyphs, idealMedoid and letterAdvance "
                           "were rebuilt from the kept variants; connectedness "
                           "is carried over unchanged because the adjacency it "
                           "was counted from is not stored")

    out = paths.Profiles/(outName or ("%s_curated.json" % writer))
    out.write_text(json.dumps(prof), encoding="utf-8")
    summary = dict(writer=writer, source=path.name, out=out.name, path=str(out),
                   removed=removed, emptied=emptied,
                   rebuilt=sorted(c for c in touched if c in glyphs),
                   nChars=len(glyphs),
                   nVariants=sum(len(v) for v in glyphs.values()),
                   note=prof["curatedNote"])
    print("removed %d variants" % removed)
    if emptied:
        print("  characters left with none, and dropped: %s" % ", ".join(repr(c) for c in emptied))
    print("  recomputed prototype, medoid and advance for: %s"
          % ", ".join(repr(c) for c in summary["rebuilt"]))
    print("  %d characters and %d variants remain" % (summary["nChars"], summary["nVariants"]))
    print("  wrote %s" % out)
    return summary
inventory.comment: ---Apply: the real work, on {char: {indices}} as the page sends them---

def Main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("action", choices=["sheet", "list", "drop"])
    ap.add_argument("writer")

def Conv2d(x,weight,bias,stride=1,padding=1):
    B,C,H,W = x.shape
    OutC,InC,kh,kw = weight.shape
    xp = np.pad(x,((0,0),(0,0),(padding,padding),(padding,padding)))
    Hp,Wp = xp.shape[2],xp.shape[3]
    outH = (Hp-kh)//stride+1
    outW = (Wp-kw)//stride+1

    s = xp.strides   #a strided view holding every patch, (B, C, kh, kw, outH, outW)
    shape = (B,C,kh,kw,outH,outW)
    strides = (s[0],s[1],s[2],s[3],s[2]*stride,s[3]*stride)
    cols = np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(xp,shape=shape,strides=strides)
    cols = cols.reshape(B,C*kh*kw,outH*outW)

    w = weight.reshape(OutC,C*kh*kw)
    out = np.stack([w@cols[b] for b in range(B)],axis=0).reshape(B,OutC,outH,outW)
    if bias is not None:
        out = out+bias.reshape(1,OutC,1,1)
    return out
inventory.comment: ---Conv2d: slides learned filters over the image by turning each patch into a column---

def MaxPool2d(x,kernel=2,stride=2):
    B,C,H,W = x.shape
    outH,outW = H//stride,W//stride
    xc = x[:,:,:outH*stride,:outW*stride]   #drop a leftover odd row or column
    st = xc.strides
    windows = np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(
        xc,shape=(B,C,outH,outW,kernel,kernel),
        strides=(st[0],st[1],st[2]*stride,st[3]*stride,st[2],st[3]))
    return windows.max(axis=(4,5))

def LogSoftmax(x,axis):

    shifted = x-m

def ConvBlockForward(x,sd,prefix,nLayers):
    for i in range(nLayers):
        c = i*3
        x = Conv2d(x,sd[f"{prefix}.{c}.weight"],sd[f"{prefix}.{c}.bias"],padding=1)
        x = BatchNorm2d(x,sd[f"{prefix}.{c+1}.weight"],sd[f"{prefix}.{c+1}.bias"],
                         sd[f"{prefix}.{c+1}.running_mean"],sd[f"{prefix}.{c+1}.running_var"])
        x = Relu(x)
    return x

inventory.source:
def LstmForward(x,weightIh,weightHh,biasIh,biasHh,hiddenSize):
    T,B,_ = x.shape
    h = np.zeros((B,hiddenSize),dtype=x.dtype)
    c = np.zeros((B,hiddenSize),dtype=x.dtype)
    H = hiddenSize
    outputs = np.empty((T,B,H),dtype=x.dtype)

    for t in range(T):
        gates = x[t]@weightIh.T+biasIh+h@weightHh.T+biasHh
        i = Sigmoid(gates[:,0*H:1*H])
        f = Sigmoid(gates[:,1*H:2*H])
        g = np.tanh(gates[:,2*H:3*H])
        o = Sigmoid(gates[:,3*H:4*H])
        c = f*c+i*g
        h = o*np.tanh(c)
        outputs[t] = h

    return outputs,(h,c)
inventory.comment: ---LstmForward: reads a sequence one column at a time through four gates, in one direction---

def StrokeNormalize(gray,penWidthXh=PenWidthXh):
    ink = BinarizeLine(gray)
    if not ink.any():
        return None
    band = CoreBand(ink)
    xh = float(band[1]-band[0]) if band else 0.0
    if xh<4:
        xh = max(8.0,ink.shape[0]/3.0)   #no usable band, take a third of the crop
    sk = Skeletonize(ink)
    if not sk.any():
        return None
    w = int(np.clip(round(penWidthXh*xh),2,9))   #width as a fraction of x-height
    k = 2*(w//2)+1   #odd, so the pen sits centred on the centreline
    return ((~Dilate(sk,k,k))*255).astype(np.uint8)   #re-ink, then invert to ink on white

inventory.source:
def CtcForcedAlign(logProbs,text):
    labels = [CHAR_TO_IDX[c] for c in text if c in CHAR_TO_IDX]
    if not labels:
        return None
    ext = [0]
    for l in labels:
        ext+=[l,0]
    S,T = len(ext),logProbs.shape[0]
    if T<len(labels):
        return None
    NEG = -1e30
    dp = np.full((T,S),NEG)
    bp = np.zeros((T,S),np.int32)
    dp[0,0] = logProbs[0,ext[0]]
    if S>1:
        dp[0,1] = logProbs[0,ext[1]]
    for t in range(1,T):
        emit = logProbs[t,ext]
        stay = dp[t-1]
        prev1 = np.concatenate(([NEG],dp[t-1,:-1]))
        prev2 = np.concatenate(([NEG,NEG],dp[t-1,:-2]))
        for s in range(S):   #a skip is allowed only onto a non-blank differing two back
            if s>=2 and (ext[s]==0 or ext[s]==ext[s-2]):
                prev2[s] = NEG
        cand = np.stack([stay,prev1,prev2])
        best = np.argmax(cand,axis=0)
        dp[t] = cand[best,np.arange(S)]+emit
        bp[t] = best
    endS = S-1 if S==1 else (S-1 if dp[T-1,S-1]>=dp[T-1,S-2] else S-2)
    path = np.zeros(T,np.int32)
    s = endS
    for t in range(T-1,-1,-1):
        path[t] = s
        s-=bp[t,s]
    spans = []
    for ci in range(len(labels)):
        sIdx = 1+2*ci
        ts = np.nonzero(path==sIdx)[0]
        if len(ts)==0:
            spans.append(None)
        else:
            spans.append((int(ts[0]),int(ts[-1])+1))
    kept = [c for c in text if c in CHAR_TO_IDX]
    conf = float(np.mean([logProbs[t,ext[path[t]]] for t in range(T)]))
    return list(zip(kept,spans)),conf
inventory.comment: CtcForcedAlign: walks the one path through the scores that spells a known text, and returns the column span of every character plus the path's mean score

class PaperCRNNNumpy:
    def __init__(self,checkpointPath=None,hiddenSize=256):
        self.checkpointPath = Path(checkpointPath or DEFAULT_TEXT_WEIGHTS)
        self.sd,_ = LoadStateDictAny(self.checkpointPath)
        self.hiddenSize = hiddenSize

        self.lstmLayerParams = []
        for l in range(2):
            def Get(name,layer=l):
                return self.sd[f"sequence.{name}_l{layer}"]

            fwd = dict(weightIh=Get("weight_ih"),weightHh=Get("weight_hh"),
                       biasIh=Get("bias_ih"),biasHh=Get("bias_hh"))
            bwd = dict(weightIh=self.sd[f"sequence.weight_ih_l{l}_reverse"],
                       weightHh=self.sd[f"sequence.weight_hh_l{l}_reverse"],
                       biasIh=self.sd[f"sequence.bias_ih_l{l}_reverse"],
                       biasHh=self.sd[f"sequence.bias_hh_l{l}_reverse"])
            self.lstmLayerParams.append({"fwd":fwd,"bwd":bwd})

    #(B,1,H,W) in, (T,B,numClasses) log probabilities out
    def Forward(self,x):
        sd = self.sd
        x = ConvBlockForward(x,sd,"stage1",2)
        x = MaxPool2d(x,2,2)
        x = ConvBlockForward(x,sd,"stage2",4)
        x = MaxPool2d(x,2,2)
        x = ConvBlockForward(x,sd,"stage3",6)
        x = AdaptiveMaxPoolHeight(x)
        x = x[:,:,0,:]
        x = np.transpose(x,(2,0,1))   #width becomes the CTC time axis
        seq = MultilayerBidirectionalLstm(x,self.lstmLayerParams,self.hiddenSize)
        logits = Linear(seq,sd["text_head.weight"],sd["text_head.bias"])
        return LogSoftmax(logits,axis=2)
inventory.comment: PaperCRNNNumpy: the reader, the convolution backbone, the LSTM stack and a score per character per column

class AuthorClassifierCNNNumpy:
    def __init__(self,checkpointPath=None):
        self.checkpointPath = Path(checkpointPath or DEFAULT_AUTHOR_WEIGHTS)
        self.sd,self.authorMapping = LoadStateDictAny(self.checkpointPath)

    #(B,1,H,W) in, (B,numAuthors) raw scores out
    def Forward(self,x):
        sd = self.sd
        x = ConvBlockForward(x,sd,"stage1",2)
        x = MaxPool2d(x,2,2)
        x = ConvBlockForward(x,sd,"stage2",4)
        x = MaxPool2d(x,2,2)
        x = ConvBlockForward(x,sd,"stage3",6)
        x = AdaptiveMaxPoolHeight(x)
        x = x[:,:,0,:]
        pooled = AdaptiveAvgPoolWidth(x)[:,:,0]
        h = Linear(pooled,sd["author_head.0.weight"],sd["author_head.0.bias"])
        h = Relu(h)
        #author_head.2 is dropout, inactive at inference
        logits = Linear(h,sd["author_head.3.weight"],sd["author_head.3.bias"])
        return logits

inventory.source:
class GantryConfig:
    #motion transmission
    fullStepsPerRev: int = 200   #NEMA 17
    microstepping: int = 16   #A4988 MS1/MS2/MS3 set to 1/16
    mmPerRevX: float = 40.0   #GT2 2 mm pitch, 20 teeth
    mmPerRevY: float = 40.0
    #work area, zero means use the switch travel
    boundsMinXmm: float = 0.0
    boundsMinYmm: float = 0.0
    boundsMaxXmm: float = 0.0
    boundsMaxYmm: float = 0.0
    originXmm: float = 0.0
    originYmm: float = 0.0   #zero means the top of the calibrated area
    #page margins, in millimetres
    pageMarginXmm: float = 15.0
    pageMarginYmm: float = 10.0
    #the ruling on the paper, and how far down the page to start
    lineHeightMm: float = 8.4
    lineOffsetMm: float = 0.0
    #the x-height as a share of the ruling, and the cap on how tall one
    #line of writing may come out as a multiple of the ruling
    rulingXhFrac: float = 0.46
    rulingMaxExtent: float = 1.25
    #speeds
    drawFeedMmMin: float = 900.0
    travelFeedMmMin: float = 2400.0
    minSegmentMm: float = 0.12   #shorter moves are collapsed
    #pen actuator: a one-way gear motor turning 90 degrees per pulse
    penUpDwellMs: float = 350.0
    penDownDwellMs: float = 350.0   #longer, to let the nib seat before drawing
    penUpCode: str = 'M5'
    penDownCode: str = 'M3'
    penStartsUp: bool = True
    #if the next stroke starts this close, the pen draws into it rather
    #than lifting, travelling a fraction of a millimetre and dropping
    joinStrokesMm: float = 0.6
    #a stroke whose own ends are this close is closed, so a ring meets itself
    closeRingMm: float = 0.6

    #the work area promised here is trimmed to what the carriage can reach
    #between the switches
    def __post_init__(self):
        usableW = X_SWITCH_TRAVEL_MM-2*EDGE_TOLERANCE_MM
        usableH = Y_SWITCH_TRAVEL_MM-2*EDGE_TOLERANCE_MM
        self.boundsMaxXmm = (usableW if self.boundsMaxXmm <= 0
                             else min(self.boundsMaxXmm, usableW))
        self.boundsMaxYmm = (usableH if self.boundsMaxYmm <= 0
                             else min(self.boundsMaxYmm, usableH))
        if self.originYmm <= 0:
            self.originYmm = self.boundsMaxYmm

    #what is left for writing once both margins are kept
    @property
    def usableWidthMm(self):
        return self.boundsMaxXmm-self.originXmm-2*self.pageMarginXmm

    @property
    def microstepsPerRev(self):
        return self.fullStepsPerRev*self.microstepping

    @property
    def stepsPerMmX(self):
        return self.microstepsPerRev/self.mmPerRevX

    @property
    def stepsPerMmY(self):
        return self.microstepsPerRev/self.mmPerRevY

inventory.source:
def ToMachine(traj,cfg,fitToBounds=True,optimizeOrder=True,rowTolMm=None):
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = traj.Bounds()
    w,h = max(1e-6,x1-x0),max(1e-6,y1-y0)
    scale = 1.0
    mx,my = cfg.pageMarginXmm,cfg.pageMarginYmm
    off = max(0.0,float(getattr(cfg,'lineOffsetMm',0.0)))
    if fitToBounds:
        #the margin comes off twice, once each side
        availW = cfg.boundsMaxXmm-cfg.originXmm-2*mx
        availH = (cfg.originYmm-my-off)-cfg.boundsMinYmm
        scale = min(1.0,availW/w,availH/h)
    #each line is placed by its own centre, not by the nominal pitch
    pitch = float(traj.meta.get('lineStepMm',0.0) or 0.0)
    ruledPitch = pitch*scale
    respace = pitch>1e-6 and int(traj.meta.get('lines',1) or 1)>1
    centres = {}
    if respace:
        rows = {}
        for s in traj.strokes:
            if not s:
                continue
            k = round(-(sum(p[1] for p in s)/len(s))/pitch)
            ys = [p[1] for p in s]
            lo,hi = rows.get(k,(1e18,-1e18))
            rows[k] = (min(lo,min(ys)),max(hi,max(ys)))
        if rows:
            k0 = min(rows)   #the topmost line stays where it is
            c0 = (rows[k0][0]+rows[k0][1])*0.5
            for k,(lo,hi) in rows.items():
                ck = (lo+hi)*0.5
                centres[k] = (c0-ck)*scale-(k-k0)*ruledPitch
    out = []
    for s in traj.strokes:
        shift = 0.0
        if respace and s:
            k = round(-(sum(p[1] for p in s)/len(s))/pitch)
            shift = centres.get(k,0.0)
        #both frames have y up, so the text's top row lands at originY
        q = [(cfg.originXmm+mx+(x-x0)*scale,
              cfg.originYmm-my-off-(y1-y)*scale+shift)
             for (x,y) in s]
        out.append(_Decimate(q,cfg.minSegmentMm))
    if optimizeOrder:
        out = OptimizeStrokeOrder(out,rowTolMm=rowTolMm)
    return out,scale
inventory.comment: ToMachine: places the drawing on the bed at the right size, shrinking it only if it would run off the work area, and sets each line's own centre one laid-out pitch below the one above

inventory.name: OptimizeStrokeOrder
inventory.source:
def OptimizeStrokeOrder(strokes,rowTolMm=None):
    if len(strokes)<3:
        return strokes
    ys = [sum(p[1] for p in s)/len(s) for s in strokes]
    if rowTolMm is None:
        heights = [max(p[1] for p in s)-min(p[1] for p in s)
                   for s in strokes]
        rowTolMm = max(1.0,1.2*float(np.median(heights)))
    order = sorted(range(len(strokes)),key=lambda i: ys[i])
    rows,cur = [],[order[0]]
    for i in order[1:]:
        if abs(ys[i]-ys[cur[-1]])<=rowTolMm:
            cur.append(i)
        else:
            rows.append(cur)
            cur = [i]
    rows.append(cur)

    out = []
    pen = None
    for row in rows:
        remaining = list(row)
        while remaining:
            if pen is None:
                k = min(remaining,key=lambda i: strokes[i][0][0])
            else:
                k = min(remaining,
                        key=lambda i: min(math.dist(pen,strokes[i][0]),
                                          math.dist(pen,strokes[i][-1])))
            remaining.remove(k)
            s = strokes[k]
            #entering from whichever end is closer costs a plotter nothing
            if pen is not None and \
                    math.dist(pen,s[-1])<math.dist(pen,s[0]):
                s = s[::-1]
            out.append(s)
            pen = s[-1]
    return out
inventory.comment: OptimizeStrokeOrder: orders the strokes in bands down the page and, inside a band, takes the nearest unvisited stroke next, which cuts the pen-up travel

def _Clamp(strokes,cfg):
    lo = (cfg.boundsMinXmm,cfg.boundsMinYmm)
    hi = (cfg.boundsMaxXmm,cfg.boundsMaxYmm)
    clipped = 0
    out = []
    for s in strokes:
        q = []
        for (x,y) in s:
            cx = min(max(x,lo[0]),hi[0])
            cy = min(max(y,lo[1]),hi[1])
            if (cx,cy)!=(x,y):
                clipped+=1
            q.append((cx,cy))
        out.append(q)
    return out,clipped
inventory.comment: ---_Clamp: holds every point inside the work area, and counts the ones moved---

def SetPenLines(state,cfg,wantUp):
    if wantUp==state[0]:
        return []
    state[0] = wantUp
    state[1]+= 1
    code = cfg.penUpCode if wantUp else cfg.penDownCode
    dwell = (cfg.penUpDwellMs if wantUp else cfg.penDownDwellMs)/1000.0
    out = [f"{code}   ; pen {'UP' if wantUp else 'DOWN'} "
           f"(one 90deg pulse of the one-way gear motor)"]

        out.append(f"G4 P{dwell:.3f}   ; wait for the 90deg rotation to finish")
    return out

inventory.signature: def WriteGcode(traj, cfg, path, title='', rowTolMm=None)
inventory.source:
def WriteGcode(traj,cfg,path,title='',rowTolMm=None):
    strokes,scale = ToMachine(traj,cfg,rowTolMm=rowTolMm)
    strokes,clipped = _Clamp(strokes,cfg)
    pen = NewPenState(cfg)
    L = []
    L.append(f"; Handwriting-Robot G-code{(' -- '+title) if title else ''}")
    L.append(f"; author={traj.meta.get('author')} strokes={len(strokes)} "
             f"scale={scale:.3f}")
    L.append(f"; steps/mm  X={cfg.stepsPerMmX:.3f}  Y={cfg.stepsPerMmY:.3f} "
             f"({cfg.microstepsPerRev} microsteps/rev)")
    L.append(f"; pen: one-way gear motor, {cfg.penUpCode}=up "
             f"{cfg.penDownCode}=down, each = one 90deg pulse")
    if clipped:
        L.append(f"; WARNING: {clipped} point(s) clamped to work area")
    L.append('G21   ; millimetres')
    L.append('G90   ; absolute')
    L+=SetPenLines(pen,cfg,True)
    L.append(f"G0 F{cfg.travelFeedMmMin:.0f}")
    here = None        #where the pen is, in millimetres
    joined = rings = 0
    joinedMm = 0.0
    drawMm = travelMm = 0.0
    for s in strokes:
        if len(s)<2:
            continue
        if (cfg.closeRingMm>0 and len(s)>3
                and math.dist(s[0],s[-1])<=cfg.closeRingMm
                and s[0]!=s[-1]):
            s = list(s)+[s[0]]
            rings += 1
        if here is not None and math.dist(here,s[0])<=cfg.joinStrokesMm:
            #already there, so draw into this stroke, the gap is drawn as
            #ink, so it is counted
            L.append(f"G1 F{cfg.drawFeedMmMin:.0f}")
            joined += 1
            joinedMm += math.dist(here,s[0])
            drawMm += math.dist(here,s[0])
        else:
            L+=SetPenLines(pen,cfg,True)
            #f is modal and shared between G0 and G1, so the travel feed is
            #restated here rather than relying on the header
            L.append(f"G0 F{cfg.travelFeedMmMin:.0f} "
                     f"X{s[0][0]:.3f} Y{s[0][1]:.3f}")
            if here is not None:
                travelMm += math.dist(here,s[0])
            L+=SetPenLines(pen,cfg,False)
            L.append(f"G1 F{cfg.drawFeedMmMin:.0f}")
        prev = s[0]
        for (x,y) in s[1:]:
            L.append(f"G1 X{x:.3f} Y{y:.3f}")
            drawMm += math.dist(prev,(x,y))
            prev = (x,y)
        here = s[-1]
    L+=SetPenLines(pen,cfg,True)
    L.append(f"G0 F{cfg.travelFeedMmMin:.0f} "
             f"X{cfg.originXmm:.3f} Y{cfg.originYmm:.3f}   ; park")
    if here is not None:
        travelMm += math.dist(here,(cfg.originXmm,cfg.originYmm))
    L.append('M2')
    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with open(path,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(L)+'\n')
    #where the writing landed, in machine millimetres with y up
    ys = [p[1] for s in strokes for p in s] or [0.0]
    xs = [p[0] for s in strokes for p in s] or [0.0]
    lineH = max(1e-6,float(getattr(cfg,'lineHeightMm',8.4)))
    off = float(getattr(cfg,'lineOffsetMm',0.0))
    firstLineY = cfg.originYmm-cfg.pageMarginYmm
    #a time budget split three ways, it ignores acceleration, so it is a
    #floor on the real time rather than a prediction of it
    drawS = 60.0*drawMm/max(1.0,cfg.drawFeedMmMin)
    travelS = 60.0*travelMm/max(1.0,cfg.travelFeedMmMin)
    #pen[1] counts toggles but not direction, so the mean dwell is used
    dwellS = pen[1]*(cfg.penUpDwellMs+cfg.penDownDwellMs)/2000.0
    return dict(lines=len(L),strokes=len(strokes),penPulses=pen[1],
                scale=scale,clipped=clipped,path=str(path),
                joinedStrokes=joined,closedRings=rings,
                joinedInkMm=round(joinedMm,2),
                drawMm=round(drawMm,1),travelMm=round(travelMm,1),
                drawSeconds=round(drawS,1),travelSeconds=round(travelS,1),
                dwellSeconds=round(dwellS,1),
                estimatedSeconds=round(drawS+travelS+dwellS,1),
                placement=dict(topYmm=round(max(ys),2),bottomYmm=round(min(ys),2),
                               leftXmm=round(min(xs),2),rightXmm=round(max(xs),2),
                               lineOffsetMm=round(off,2),lineHeightMm=round(lineH,3),
                               lineIndex=int(round(off/lineH)),
                               #the pitch the lines were really drawn at
                               drawnPitchMm=round(
                                   float(traj.meta.get('lineStepMm',0.0) or 0.0)*scale,2),
                               #ruled lines this job occupies, so the page
                               #advances by that and not by one
                               textLines=max(1,int(traj.meta.get('lines',1) or 1)),
                               firstLineYmm=round(firstLineY,2),
                               linesOnPage=int((firstLineY-cfg.boundsMinYmm)//lineH)+1,
                               bedTopYmm=round(cfg.originYmm,2),
                               bedBottomYmm=round(cfg.boundsMinYmm,2),
                               bedLeftXmm=round(cfg.originXmm,2),
                               bedRightXmm=round(cfg.boundsMaxXmm,2)))
inventory.comment: WriteGcode: a pen path in, a G-code file out, a pen-up move to the start of each stroke, a pen down, the stroke at drawing feed, and a pen up at the end

def _RetractOffSwitch(hit,ignore=frozenset()):
    global CurrentXSteps,CurrentYSteps
    isX = hit.startswith("X")
    sign = _RETREAT_SIGN[hit]
    dirPin,stepPin = (DIR1_PIN,STEP1_PIN) if isX else (DIR2_PIN,STEP2_PIN)
    invert = INVERT_X if isX else INVERT_Y
    stepsPerMm = Calibration["steps_per_mm_x"] if isX else Calibration["steps_per_mm_y"]
    TargetSteps = max(1,round(RETRACT_MM*stepsPerMm))

    req.set_value(dirPin,AxisDirValue(invert,sign>0))
    moved = 0
    for _ in range(TargetSteps):
        if TriggeredEndstop(ignore={hit}|set(ignore)) is not None:
            break   #something else tripped, so stop pushing
        req.set_value(stepPin,Value.ACTIVE)
        time.sleep(HOMING_STEP_DELAY_S)
        req.set_value(stepPin,Value.INACTIVE)
        time.sleep(HOMING_STEP_DELAY_S)
        moved+=sign

    if isX:
        CurrentXSteps+=moved
    else:
        CurrentYSteps+=moved
inventory.comment: ---_RetractOffSwitch: steps an axis off a switch that is pressed, before anything else is allowed---

def EmergencyStop(waitS=3.0,park=True):
    Connect()
    abortEvent.set()
    deadline = time.time()+waitS
    while _jobActive.is_set() and time.time()<deadline:
        time.sleep(0.005)
    stillRunning = _jobActive.is_set()

    req.set_value(STEP1_PIN,Value.INACTIVE)
    req.set_value(STEP2_PIN,Value.INACTIVE)

    #forced, so the pen lifts even in a fault
    penUp = SetPen(True,force=True)
    parked,detail = False,""
    if stillRunning:
        detail = ("the drawing thread did not let go within %.1f s, so the "
                  "stop is still latched and the corner move was skipped"%waitS)
    else:
        abortEvent.clear()   #cleared before the park move
        if not park:
            detail = "parking not asked for"
        elif not Calibration["done"]:
            detail = ("not calibrated, so there is no known corner to drive "
                      "to -- the pen is up and the motors are idle")
        elif TriggeredEndstop() is not None:
            detail = ("end-stop %s is tripped, so the corner move was skipped "
                      "-- clear it, then re-home"%TriggeredEndstop())
        else:
            cfg = GantryConfig()
            _GcodeLinearMove(cfg.originXmm,cfg.originYmm,cfg.travelFeedMmMin)
            parked = True
    print("[stop] pen %s, %s%s"%("up" if penUp else "UP FAILED",
                                 "parked at the corner" if parked else "not parked",
                                 " -- "+detail if detail else ""))
    return {"stopped": True,"pen_up": bool(penUp),"parked": parked,
            "still_running": stillRunning,"latched": stillRunning,
            "detail": detail,"estopped": estopped,
            "tripped_switch": TrippedSwitch}
inventory.comment: EmergencyStop: stops the running job, lifts the pen and parks at the corner, in that order, the stop latches only if the drawing thread fails to let go

def BresenhamMove(dx,dy,stepDelayS=MIN_STEP_DELAY_S):
    global CurrentXSteps,CurrentYSteps
    ax,ay = abs(dx),abs(dy)
    sx = 1 if dx>=0 else -1
    sy = 1 if dy>=0 else -1
    req.set_value(DIR1_PIN,AxisDirValue(INVERT_X,sx>0))
    req.set_value(DIR2_PIN,AxisDirValue(INVERT_Y,sy>0))

    def Pulse(stepPin):
        req.set_value(stepPin,Value.ACTIVE)
        time.sleep(stepDelayS)
        req.set_value(stepPin,Value.INACTIVE)

    if ax>=ay:   #x is the major axis
        err = ax//2
        for _ in range(ax):
            #checked per step, not per move, so a stop takes effect at once
            if abortEvent.is_set() or TriggeredEndstop() is not None:
                return
            Pulse(STEP1_PIN)
            CurrentXSteps+=sx
            err-=ay
            if err<0:   #the minor axis catches up by one step
                Pulse(STEP2_PIN)
                CurrentYSteps+=sy
                err+=ax
    else:   #y is the major axis
        err = ay//2
        for _ in range(ay):
            if abortEvent.is_set() or TriggeredEndstop() is not None:
                return
            Pulse(STEP2_PIN)
            CurrentYSteps+=sy
            err-=ax
            if err<0:
                Pulse(STEP1_PIN)
                CurrentXSteps+=sx
                err+=ay
inventory.comment: BresenhamMove: a straight line in whole steps, a running error term steps whichever axis is furthest behind, so the two motors stay on the line

def Calibrate():
    global CurrentXSteps,CurrentYSteps

    if TriggeredEndstop() is not None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot calibrate -- end-stop {TrippedSwitch} already tripped.")

    print("[calibrate] === X axis ===")
    _,xSecond,xTravel = _CalibrateAxis(STEP1_PIN,DIR1_PIN,"X_MIN","X_MAX")
    CurrentXSteps = xTravel if xSecond=="X_MAX" else 0
    Calibration["steps_per_mm_x"] = xTravel/X_SWITCH_TRAVEL_MM
    _RetractOffSwitch(xSecond)
    print(f"[calibrate] retracted off {xSecond}.")

    print("[calibrate] === Y axis ===")
    _,ySecond,yTravel = _CalibrateAxis(

def _GcodeLinearMove(targetXMm,targetYMm,feedMmMin):
    targetXMm,targetYMm = _ClampToUsableArea(targetXMm,targetYMm)
    spmmX,spmmY = Calibration["steps_per_mm_x"],Calibration["steps_per_mm_y"]
    #zero in this frame is EDGE_TOLERANCE_MM in from the min switch
    x0Mm = CurrentXSteps/spmmX-EDGE_TOLERANCE_MM
    y0Mm = CurrentYSteps/spmmY-EDGE_TOLERANCE_MM
    distMm = math.hypot(targetXMm-x0Mm,targetYMm-y0Mm)
    TargetXSteps = round((targetXMm+EDGE_TOLERANCE_MM)*spmmX)
    TargetYSteps = round((targetYMm+EDGE_TOLERANCE_MM)*spmmY)
    dxSteps = TargetXSteps-CurrentXSteps
    dySteps = TargetYSteps-CurrentYSteps

    majorSteps = max(abs(dxSteps),abs(dySteps),1)
    feedMmS = max(feedMmMin/60.0,GCODE_MIN_FEED_MM_S)
    stepDelayS = max((distMm/feedMmS)/majorSteps,MIN_STEP_DELAY_S)
    BresenhamMove(dxSteps,dySteps,stepDelayS=stepDelayS)

def PageStrokes(gray, timer=None):
    lines, _dbg, info = SEG.SegmentLines(gray, timer=timer)
    strokes = []
    perLine = []
    for ln in lines:
        crop = np.asarray(ln["image"], dtype=np.uint8)
        ink = SEG.BinarizeLine(crop)
        if not ink.any():
            perLine.append(0)
            continue
        polys = ST.TracePolylines(SEG.Skeletonize(ink))
        x0, y0 = (ln["bbox"][0], ln["bbox"][1]) if "bbox" in ln else (0, 0)
        kept = 0
        for p in polys:
            if len(p) < MIN_STROKE_PTS:
                continue
            #y is flipped here: the page counts rows downwards, a trajectory
            #counts millimetres upwards, and the writer flips nothing
            strokes.append([(float(x)+x0, -(float(y)+y0)) for (x, y) in p])
            kept += 1
        perLine.append(kept)
    return strokes, dict(lines=len(lines), strokesPerLine=perLine, **info)
inventory.comment: PageStrokes: a photographed page as pen paths in page coordinates each line is conditioned and cut out by the ordinary segmenter, then its ink is thinned and followed.  the crop's own offset puts every path back where it belongs on the page, so the result is one coordinate system

def RetracePage(imagePath, outPath, cfg=None, previewPath=None):
    cfg = cfg or REP.GantryConfig()
    run = TIMING.Run("retrace")

    with run.Step("loading"):
        gray = TR.ReadImageFile(imagePath)

    strokes, info = PageStrokes(gray, timer=run)
    with run.Step("tracing"):
        strokes = PruneSpecks(strokes, info.get("pitch", 40)*0.4)
    if not strokes:
        raise SystemExit("no ink found to trace in %s" % imagePath)

    traj = SYN.Trajectory(strokes, dict(author="retrace", source=str(imagePath),
                                        lines=info["lines"]))
    #OptimizeStrokeOrder works out its row tolerance from how tall the strokes
    #are, which is right for one synthesised line and wrong for a page: a
    #stroke is a part of a letter, not a line, so the tolerance comes out at
    #about a third of the line pitch and each text line is treated as three
    #rows.  the pitch is known here, so it is passed in instead
    with run.Step("gcode"):
        written = REP.WriteGcode(traj, cfg, str(outPath),
                                 title="retrace of %s" % Path(imagePath).name,
                                 rowTolMm=LinePitchMm(info, cfg, traj))

    preview = None
    if previewPath:
        with run.Step("preview"):
            preview = SYN.RenderTrajectory(traj, pxPerMm=6.0)
            from PIL import Image
            Image.fromarray(np.asarray(preview, dtype=np.uint8)).save(previewPath)

    run.chars = 0
    run.lines = info["lines"]
    #WriteGcode reports a stroke count of its own, after ordering and clamping
    out = dict(written)
    out.update(gcode=str(outPath), tracedStrokes=len(strokes), timing=run.AsDict(),
               preview=str(previewPath) if previewPath else None)
    return out
inventory.comment: RetracePage: the whole job, photograph in and a g-code file out the trajectory is handed to the ordinary writer, so the page is placed, scaled to the work area and ordered by exactly the same code a synthesised line goes through.  only the source of the strokes differs

def Integral(img):
    ii = np.zeros((img.shape[0]+1,img.shape[1]+1),np.float64)
    np.cumsum(np.cumsum(img,axis=0),axis=1,out=ii[1:,1:])
    return ii
inventory.comment: Integral: running total of the image, cell (y,x) holds everything above and left of it, so any rectangle sum is four lookups

def BoxSum(img,ry,rx):
    h,w = img.shape
    ii = Integral(img)
    y,x = np.arange(h),np.arange(w)
    y1,y2 = np.clip(y-ry,0,h)[:,None],np.clip(y+ry+1,0,h)[:,None]
    x1,x2 = np.clip(x-rx,0,w)[None,:],np.clip(x+rx+1,0,w)[None,:]
    return ii[y2,x2]-ii[y1,x2]-ii[y2,x1]+ii[y1,x1]   #BR - TR - BL + TL
inventory.comment: ---BoxSum: the window sum around every pixel at once, from that running total---

    cx = (np.clip(x+rx+1,0,w)-np.clip(x-rx,0,w))[None,:]

def RowRunLength(mask):
    h,w = mask.shape
    a = mask.astype(np.int32)
    starts = np.zeros_like(a)
    starts[:,0] = a[:,0]
    starts[:,1:] = (a[:,1:]==1)&(a[:,:-1]==0)   #a run starts where the row steps 0 to 1
    runId = np.cumsum(starts.reshape(-1)).reshape(h,w)
    runId[a==0] = 0
    if runId.max()==0:
        return np.zeros_like(a)
    counts = np.bincount(runId.reshape(-1))
    counts[0] = 0
    return counts[runId]
inventory.comment: ---RowRunLength: for every pixel, the length of the unbroken run of ink through it along its row---

inventory.name: Otsu
inventory.source:
def Otsu(v,hi=None):
    a = np.asarray(v)
    isInt = np.issubdtype(a.dtype,np.integer)
    if isInt:
        hist = np.bincount(a.ravel(),minlength=256).astype(np.float64)
    else:
        hi = 1.2 if hi is None else float(hi)
        hist = np.histogram(np.clip(a,0,hi),bins=256,range=(0,hi))[0].astype(np.float64)
    p = hist/max(hist.sum(),1.0)
    w = np.cumsum(p)   #mass at or below each bin
    m = np.cumsum(p*np.arange(256))
    var = (m[-1]*w-m)**2/np.maximum(w*(1-w),1e-12)
    t = int(np.argmax(var))
    return t if isInt else (t+0.5)*hi/256   #bin index for ints, bin centre for floats
inventory.comment: ---Otsu: the threshold maximising between-class variance over the histogram---

inventory.name: BinarizeLine
inventory.source:
def BinarizeLine(gray,stripRules=True,closeGaps=True):
    ink = np.asarray(gray)<Otsu(np.asarray(gray,dtype=np.uint8))
    h = ink.shape[0]
    if stripRules and ink.any():
        hRun = RowRunLength(ink)
        vRun = RowRunLength(ink.T).T
        thin = vRun<=max(3,int(0.12*h))
        rule = (hRun>=max(24,int(1.1*h)))&thin   #long and thin
        if rule.any():
            ink = ink&~(rule&thin)
    if closeGaps and ink.any():
        k = int(np.clip(round(0.045*h),2,4))
        ink = Close(ink,k,k)
    labels,n = LabelComponents(ink)
    if n:
        areas = np.bincount(labels.ravel())
        keep = areas>=6
        keep[0] = False
        ink = keep[labels]
    return ink
inventory.comment: BinarizeLine: a grey line crop to a clean ink mask, threshold, close pinholes, drop specks, and remove long thin runs, which are printed rules

def CoreBand(ink):
    prof = ink.sum(axis=1).astype(np.float64)
    if prof.max()<=0:
        return None
    rows = np.nonzero(prof>=0.45*prof.max())[0]
    top,base = int(rows[0]),int(rows[-1])
    return (top,base) if base-top>=3 else None

inventory.name: LabelComponents
inventory.source:
def LabelComponents(mask):
    H,W = mask.shape
    lab = np.zeros((H,W),np.int32)
    parent = [0]

    def Find(a):
        while parent[a]!=a:
            parent[a] = parent[parent[a]]   #flatten the chain while walking it
            a = parent[a]
        return a

    prev = []
    for y in range(H):
        d = np.diff(np.r_[0,mask[y].view(np.int8),0])   #runs start at 0 to 1, end at 1 to 0
        cur,k = [],0
        for a,b in zip(np.nonzero(d==1)[0].tolist(),np.nonzero(d==-1)[0].tolist()):
            while k<len(prev) and prev[k][1]<a:
                k+=1
            l,kk = 0,k
            while kk<len(prev) and prev[kk][0]<=b:   #<=b counts a diagonal touch
                r = Find(prev[kk][2])
                if l==0:
                    l = r
                elif r!=l:
                    parent[max(r,l)] = min(r,l)
                    l = min(r,l)
                kk+=1
            if l==0:
                parent.append(len(parent))
                l = len(parent)-1
            cur.append((a,b,l))
            lab[y,a:b] = l
        prev = cur
    roots = np.array([Find(i) for i in range(len(parent))])
    _,comp = np.unique(roots,return_inverse=True)   #renumber 1..n after the merges
    return comp[lab].astype(np.int32),int(comp.max())
inventory.comment: LabelComponents: numbers every eight-connected blob of ink, row by row, merging the runs that touch the row above through a union-find

def PieceBounds(labelAt,ys,xs,n,H,W):
    top,bot = np.full(n+1,H),np.zeros(n+1,int)
    left,right = np.full(n+1,W),np.zeros(n+1,int)
    np.minimum.at(top,labelAt,ys)
    np.maximum.at(bot,labelAt,ys)
    np.minimum.at(left,labelAt,xs)
    np.maximum.at(right,labelAt,xs)
    area = np.bincount(labelAt,minlength=n+1).astype(float)
    return top,bot,left,right,area
inventory.comment: ---PieceBounds: the bounding box and pixel count of every numbered piece, in one pass---

def _Weights(inSize,outSize,kernel):
    scale = inSize/float(outSize)
    filterScale = max(1.0,scale)
    support = (1.0 if kernel=='linear' else 0.5)*filterScale
    centres = (np.arange(outSize)+0.5)*scale   #output centre, in input coordinates
    half = int(np.ceil(support))+1
    cols = np.floor(centres)[:,None]+np.arange(-half,half+1)[None,:]
    t = (cols+0.5-centres[:,None])/filterScale   #distance from the window centre
    if kernel=='linear':
        w = np.where(np.abs(t)<1.0,1.0-np.abs(t),0.0)   #triangle
    else:
        w = np.where(np.abs(t)<=0.5,1.0,0.0)   #box
    cc = np.clip(cols,0,inSize-1).astype(np.int64)   #fold a window running off the image back on
    out = np.zeros((outSize,inSize),np.float64)
    np.add.at(out,(np.repeat(np.arange(outSize),cols.shape[1]),cc.ravel()),w.ravel())
    tot = out.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    return out/np.where(tot>0,tot,1.0)   #each row sums to one
inventory.comment: _Weights: the resampling weights for one axis, the filter widens when shrinking so every input pixel still contributes

def FitFixedCanvas(gray,height,width,padValue=255):
    a = np.asarray(gray)
    h,w = a.shape[0],a.shape[1]
    canvas = np.full((height,width),padValue,np.uint8)
    if w<=0 or h<=0:
        return canvas
    s = min(height/float(h),width/float(w))
    newW,newH = max(1,int(round(w*s))),max(1,int(round(h*s)))
    small = Resize(a.astype(np.uint8),newW,newH,'linear')
    y0 = max(0,(height-newH)//2)   #vertically centred, left flush
    canvas[y0:y0+newH,:newW] = small[:height-y0,:width]

def Rotate(gray,deg,fill=255):
    a = np.asarray(gray).astype(np.float64)
    h,w = a.shape[0],a.shape[1]
    th = np.radians(float(deg))
    c,s = np.cos(th),np.sin(th)
    cy,cx = (h-1)/2.0,(w-1)/2.0
    yy,xx = np.meshgrid(np.arange(h,dtype=np.float64),
                        np.arange(w,dtype=np.float64),indexing='ij')
    dx,dy = xx-cx,yy-cy
    #rows run downward, so this is the transpose of the textbook matrix
    return _Like(_Sample(a,c*dx-s*dy+cx,s*dx+c*dy+cy,fill),gray)

def Elastic(gray,sigma,alpha,rng):
    a = np.asarray(gray).astype(np.float64)
    h,w = a.shape
    dx = Blur(rng.uniform(-1,1,(h,w)),sigma,mode='constant')*alpha
    dy = Blur(rng.uniform(-1,1,(h,w)),sigma,mode='constant')*alpha
    yy,xx = np.meshgrid(np.arange(h,dtype=np.float64),
                        np.arange(w,dtype=np.float64),indexing='ij')

def DrawPolyline(img,pts,value,width):
    if len(pts)==0:
        return img
    h,w = img.shape[0],img.shape[1]
    r = max(0.5,float(width)/2.0)
    val = np.uint8(np.clip(round(float(value)),0,255))
    segs = [(pts[i],pts[i+1]) for i in range(len(pts)-1)] or [(pts[0],pts[0])]
    for (ax,ay),(bx,by) in segs:
        x0,x1 = max(0,int(min(ax,bx)-r)-1),min(w,int(max(ax,bx)+r)+2)
        y0,y1 = max(0,int(min(ay,by)-r)-1),min(h,int(max(ay,by)+r)+2)
        if x1<=x0 or y1<=y0:
            continue
        yy,xx = np.meshgrid(np.arange(y0,y1,dtype=np.float64),
                            np.arange(x0,x1,dtype=np.float64),indexing='ij')
        vx,vy = bx-ax,by-ay
        L2 = vx*vx+vy*vy
        if L2<=1e-12:
            d = np.hypot(xx-ax,yy-ay)
        else:
            t = np.clip(((xx-ax)*vx+(yy-ay)*vy)/L2,0.0,1.0)   #how far along the segment
            d = np.hypot(xx-(ax+t*vx),yy-(ay+t*vy))
        img[y0:y1,x0:x1] = np.where(d<=r,val,img[y0:y1,x0:x1])
    return img
inventory.comment: DrawPolyline: draws a polyline with a round pen, filling where the distance to the nearest point on a segment is within half the pen width

def InkMask(gray):
    r = max(8,min(40,round(gray.shape[0]/41)))   #background radius scales with the image
    ratio = gray/np.maximum(BoxMean(gray,r),1.0)
    mask = ratio<Otsu(ratio)
    solid = BoxMean(mask.astype(np.float64),4)>0.999   #a solid 9x9 block is not writing
    return mask&~(BoxMean(solid.astype(np.float64),3)>0),ratio

def PaperRegionMask(g,P):
    H,W = g.shape
    s = 4
    c = BoxMean(g[:H//s*s,:W//s*s].reshape(H//s,s,W//s,s).mean((1,3)),max(1,int(0.15*P/s)))
    dark = c<0.45*np.median(c)
    if dark.mean()<0.002:
        return np.ones((H,W),bool)
    lab,n = LabelComponents(~dark)
    big = np.kron(lab==np.bincount(lab.ravel())[1:].argmax()+1,np.ones((s,s),bool))
    full = np.ones((H,W),bool)
    full[:big.shape[0],:big.shape[1]] = big
    r = int(0.4*P)
    return ~AnyWithinRadius(AnyWithinRadius(~full,r,0),r,1)   #shrink in from the paper edge
inventory.comment: PaperRegionMask: the sheet inside the photograph, the biggest bright blob, found on a block-averaged copy and blown back up

inventory.source:
def _LetterHeight(mask):
    lab,nc = LabelComponents(mask)
    if nc<=0:
        return None
    ys,xs = np.nonzero(mask)
    pl = lab[ys,xs]
    top,bot = np.full(nc+1,mask.shape[0]),np.zeros(nc+1,int)
    np.minimum.at(top,pl,ys)
    np.maximum.at(bot,pl,ys)
    area = np.bincount(pl,minlength=nc+1)
    hts = bot-top+1
    sel = (area>=8)&(hts>=3)&(hts<=mask.shape[0])
    if not sel[1:].any():
        return None
    return float(np.median(hts[1:][sel[1:]]))
inventory.comment: ---_LetterHeight: the median height of the ink blobs, ignoring specks and page-tall pieces---

inventory.name: LinePitch
inventory.source:
def LinePitch(mask):
    W = mask.shape[1]
    prof = mask[:,int(0.05*W):int(0.97*W)].sum(1).astype(float)
    k = np.exp(-0.5*(np.arange(-12,13)/4.0)**2)
    sm = np.convolve(prof,k/k.sum(),"same")

    h = _LetterHeight(mask)
    floor = (PEAK_MIN_PITCH_XH*h) if h else 0.0   #a gap below this is within one line

    peaks = [i for i in range(1,len(sm)-1) if sm[i]>=sm[i-1] and sm[i]>sm[i+1] and sm[i]>0.06*sm.max()]
    if len(peaks)>=2:
        p = int(np.median(np.diff(sorted(peaks))))
        if p>=floor:
            return p,sm

    a = sm-sm.mean()
    ac = np.correlate(a,a,"full")[len(a)-1:]
    seg = ac[15:min(200,len(ac)//3)]
    idx = next((i for i in range(1,len(seg)-1)
                if seg[i]>=0.7*seg.max() and seg[i]>=seg[i-1] and seg[i]>=seg[i+1]), None)
    if idx is not None and 15+idx>=floor:
        return 15+idx,sm

    if h:
        return max(MIN_LINE_PITCH,int(round(2.2*h))),sm
    return 48,sm
inventory.comment: LinePitch: the spacing between lines, the median gap between peaks of the smoothed ink-per-row profile, with autocorrelation and letter height as fallbacks

inventory.name: LeastCostSeam
inventory.source:
def LeastCostSeam(cost,step=3):
    h,W = cost.shape
    acc = cost.copy()
    back = np.zeros((h,W),np.int8)
    idx = np.arange(h)
    shifts = range(-step,step+1)
    for x in range(1,W):
        p = acc[:,x-1]
        cand = np.full((len(shifts),h),np.inf)
        for i,d in enumerate(shifts):
            if d<0:
                cand[i,-d:] = p[:d]+0.02*abs(d)   #a small cost for moving off straight ahead
            elif d>0:
                cand[i,:-d] = p[d:]+0.02*d
            else:
                cand[i] = p
        j = cand.argmin(0)
        acc[:,x]+=cand[j,idx]
        back[:,x] = j-step
    y = np.empty(W,int)
    y[-1] = acc[:,-1].argmin()
    for x in range(W-1,0,-1):
        y[x-1] = y[x]+back[y[x],x]
    return y
inventory.comment: LeastCostSeam: the cheapest path left to right across a cost field, keeping the best running cost of reaching each row and backtracking at the end

inventory.name: SkewScore
inventory.source:
def SkewScore(mask,angleDeg):
    ys,xs = np.nonzero(mask)
    if len(ys)==0:
        return 0.0
    h = mask.shape[0]
    cy,cx = (h-1)/2.0,(mask.shape[1]-1)/2.0
    th = np.radians(float(angleDeg))
    k = np.rint((ys-cy)*np.cos(th)-(xs-cx)*np.sin(th)+cy).astype(np.int64)
    k -= k.min()   #shifted to zero, not clipped: clipping piles off-page ink into one row
    prof = np.bincount(k).astype(np.float64)
    return float((prof**2).sum())
inventory.comment: SkewScore: the sum of the squared ink per row at a trial angle, which peaks when the page is level

inventory.name: Deskew
inventory.source:
def Deskew(page):
    full = np.asarray(page,dtype=np.uint8)
    if full.ndim==3:
        full = np.rint(full[...,:3].mean(2)).astype(np.uint8)
    halfA = Halve(full)

    mask,_ = InkMask(halfA.astype(np.float64))
    q = Halve(mask.astype(np.uint8)*255)>127
    best = max(np.arange(-4,4.01,0.5),key=lambda a: SkewScore(q,a))
    #fill 255: whatever rotates in from outside the photograph is paper
    fullA = Rotate(full,best,fill=255)
    halfA = Rotate(halfA,best,fill=255)
    g = halfA.astype(np.float64)
    mask,ratio = InkMask(g)
    return fullA,halfA,mask,ratio,best
inventory.comment: Deskew: scores a range of angles on a quarter-size mask, rotates to the best, and returns the full and half-resolution pages with the ink mask and ratio

inventory.name: RemovePrintedStructure
inventory.source:
def RemovePrintedStructure(mask,g):
    P,_ = LinePitch(mask)
    paper = PaperRegionMask(g,P)
    paperRemoved = int((mask&~paper).sum())
    mask&=paper
    flat = AnyWithinRadius(LongRunMask(AnyWithinRadius(mask,1,0),int(1.25*P),1),1,0)&mask
    upright = AnyWithinRadius(LongRunMask(AnyWithinRadius(mask,3,1),int(1.4*P),0),3,1)&mask
    removed = int((flat|upright).sum())
    mask = mask&~flat&~upright
    return mask,paper,P,paperRemoved,removed
inventory.comment: ---RemovePrintedStructure: masks off everything outside the sheet, then deletes long straight runs---

inventory.name: DropArtifactPieces
inventory.signature: def DropArtifactPieces(mask, ratio, P, H, W)
inventory.source:
def DropArtifactPieces(mask,ratio,P,H,W):
    rc = max(1,int(0.1*P))
    dil = AnyWithinRadius(AnyWithinRadius(mask,rc,0),rc,1)
    closed = ~AnyWithinRadius(AnyWithinRadius(~dil,rc,0),rc,1)
    lab,nc = LabelComponents(closed)
    ys,xs = np.nonzero(mask)
    pl = lab[ys,xs]
    area = np.bincount(pl,minlength=nc+1).astype(float)
    top,bot,xmin,xmax,_ = PieceBounds(pl,ys,xs,nc,H,W)
    tall = (bot-top+1)>2.2*P
    thin = (xmax-xmin+1)<=0.5*P
    edgeTol = max(3,int(0.5*P))   #this close to the paper boundary counts as page
    touchL,touchR = xmin<=edgeTol,xmax>=W-1-edgeTol
    touchT,touchB = top<=edgeTol,bot>=H-1-edgeTol
    thinV = (bot-top+1)<=0.5*P
    letters = (area>=0.065*P*P)&~tall
    #where the text block starts on the left, judged from the letters alone
    xL = np.percentile(xmin[letters],5) if letters.any() else -np.inf
    vbar = ((xmax-xmin+1)<=0.12*P)&((bot-top+1)>=1.2*P)
    otsuT = Otsu(ratio)
    #bincount with weights sums the ratio per piece, giving its mean darkness
    meanRatio = np.bincount(pl,weights=ratio[ys,xs],minlength=nc+1)/np.maximum(area,1)
    faint = meanRatio>0.85*otsuT
    faintVbar = faint&((xmax-xmin+1)<=0.2*P)&((bot-top+1)>=0.6*P)

    density = area/np.maximum((bot-top+1)*(xmax-xmin+1),1)
    edgeHeight = (bot-top+1)<=1.2*P
    edgeShadow = (touchT|touchB)&edgeHeight&(density<0.15)&faint&((xmax-xmin+1)>P)

    drop = (touchL|(touchR&thin)|((touchT|touchB)&thinV&thin)
            |(tall&thin)|vbar|faintVbar|edgeShadow|(xmax<xL-1.2*P))
    drop[0] = False
    nArtifacts = int(drop.sum())
    mask&=~drop[lab]
    return mask,lab,nc,area,nArtifacts
inventory.comment: DropArtifactPieces: drops whole pieces that are not writing, edge slivers, pieces far too big or too thin, faint vertical bars and crease shadows

inventory.name: LineCentres
inventory.source:
def LineCentres(mask,H,mergeValley=None):
    P,sm = LinePitch(mask)
    peaks = [i for i in range(1,H-1) if sm[i]>=sm[i-1] and sm[i]>sm[i+1] and sm[i]>0.06*sm.max()]
    centres = []
    for c in sorted(peaks,key=lambda i:-sm[i]):
        if all(abs(c-o)>=0.6*P for o in centres):
            centres.append(c)
    centres.sort()

    thr = LINE_MERGE_VALLEY if mergeValley is None else float(mergeValley)
    while len(centres)>1 and thr<1.0:
        ratios = [(float(sm[a:b+1].min())/max(float(min(sm[a],sm[b])),1e-9),i)
                  for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(centres,centres[1:]))]
        worst,i = max(ratios)
        if worst<=thr:
            break
        centres.pop(i+1 if sm[centres[i]]>=sm[centres[i+1]] else i)

    return P,centres
inventory.comment: LineCentres: the row each line sits on, profile peaks kept at least 0.6 pitches apart, then optionally merged where the dip between two of them is shallow

inventory.name: SeamCuts
inventory.signature: def SeamCuts(mask, centres, P, H, W)
inventory.source:
def SeamCuts(mask,centres,P,H,W):
    cuts = [np.full(W,max(0,centres[0]-int(0.75*P)))]
    tailR = max(2,int(0.07*P))
    #closing, not plain dilation: it fills the thin gap a seam could thread
    #through beside a stem while leaving the stroke's outer shape near real
    mdil = AnyWithinRadius(AnyWithinRadius(mask,tailR,0),tailR,1)
    mClosed = ~AnyWithinRadius(AnyWithinRadius(~mdil,tailR,0),tailR,1)
    m = mClosed.astype(np.float64)

    for c0,c1 in zip(centres,centres[1:]):
        yy = np.arange(c0,c1+1)[:, None]
        mid,halfGap = c0+0.5*(c1-c0),max(1.0,(c1-c0)/2.0)
        #the quadratic term pulls the seam gently back towards the midline
        cuts.append(c0+LeastCostSeam(4.0*m[c0:c1+1]+0.012*((yy-mid)/halfGap)**2,step=7))

    cuts.append(np.full(W,min(H-1,centres[-1]+int(0.75*P))))
    L = len(cuts)-1
    cutsArr = np.array(cuts)
    return cuts,cutsArr,L
inventory.comment: SeamCuts: a least-ink seam between each pair of line centres, so the cut goes around descenders instead of through them

inventory.name: _BandOwnership
inventory.signature: def _BandOwnership(mask, lab, nc, cuts, cutsArr, L, P, H, W, centres)
inventory.source:
def _BandOwnership(mask,lab,nc,cuts,cutsArr,L,P,H,W,centres):
    ys,xs = np.nonzero(mask)
    pl = lab[ys,xs]
    Y = np.arange(H)[:, None]
    #band index = how many seam boundaries sit above this pixel
    region = sum((Y>=cuts[n][None,:]).astype(np.int16) for n in range(1,L)) if L>1 else np.zeros((H,W),np.int16)
    rp = region[ys,xs]
    ok = (ys>=cutsArr[0][xs])&(ys<cutsArr[-1][xs])
    area = np.bincount(pl,minlength=nc+1).astype(float)

    A = np.bincount(pl,minlength=nc+1).astype(float)
    cx = np.bincount(pl,xs,nc+1)/np.maximum(A,1)
    cy = np.bincount(pl,ys,nc+1)/np.maximum(A,1)
    #(piece,band) packed into one integer, so one bincount gives the table
    cnt = np.bincount(pl[ok]*L+rp[ok],minlength=(nc+1)*L).reshape(nc+1,L)
    substantial = cnt>=0.15*np.maximum(cnt.sum(1,keepdims=True),1)
    regionIdx = np.where(substantial,np.arange(L)[None,:],L)
    #a piece spanning two lines is reserved for the topmost it touches
    major = np.where(substantial.any(1),regionIdx.min(1),cnt.argmax(1))

    minor = (cnt>0)&(cnt<0.12*P*P)&(cnt<0.35*cnt.sum(1,keepdims=True))&(np.abs(np.arange(L)[None,:]-major[:, None])==1)
    key = pl[ok]*L+rp[ok]
    xlo,xhi = np.full((nc+1)*L,W),np.zeros((nc+1)*L,int)
    np.minimum.at(xlo,key,xs[ok])
    np.maximum.at(xhi,key,xs[ok])
    minor&=((xhi-xlo+1).reshape(nc+1,L)<=0.55*P)   #a cut-off tail is narrow
    big = (cnt.sum(1)>=0.05*P*P)
    tiny = np.zeros(nc+1,bool)
    for l in np.nonzero((cnt.sum(1)>0)&(cnt.sum(1)<0.06*P*P))[0]:
        n = major[l]
        near = big&(major==n)&(np.abs(cx-cx[l])<=6*P)
        tiny[l] = True
        speck = cnt[l].sum()<0.01*P*P
        if not near.any() or (speck and not (near&(np.abs(cx-cx[l])<=3*P)).any()):
            major[l] = -1   #nowhere near its line's writing
            continue
        yc = np.median(cy[near&(np.abs(cx-cx[l])<=1.5*P)]) if (near&(np.abs(cx-cx[l])<=1.5*P)).any() else np.median(cy[near])
        if cy[l]-yc>0.5*P and n+1<L:
            major[l] = -1 if speck else n+1
        elif yc-cy[l]>0.7*P and n>0:
            major[l] = -1 if speck else n-1
    for l in np.nonzero((cnt.sum(1)>=0.06*P*P)&(cnt.sum(1)<0.15*P*P)&(major>=0))[0]:
        pick,bd = major[l],np.inf
        for n in (major[l]-1,major[l],major[l]+1):
            rows = big&(major==n)&(np.abs(cx-cx[l])<=1.5*P)
            if 0<=n<L and rows.any() and abs(np.median(cy[rows])-cy[l])<bd:
                pick,bd = n,abs(np.median(cy[rows])-cy[l])
        major[l],tiny[l] = pick, True
    #a dot goes with the letter body directly below it
    top2,bot2,x0b,x1b,_ = PieceBounds(pl,ys,xs,nc,H,W)
    hh,ww = bot2-top2+1,x1b-x0b+1
    dot = (A>0)&(A<0.1*P*P)&(np.maximum(hh,ww)<=0.45*P)&(np.maximum(hh,ww)<=2.2*np.maximum(np.minimum(hh,ww),1))
    stem = (A>=0.03*P*P)&~dot
    for l in np.nonzero(dot&(major>=0))[0]:
        xa,xb = max(0,x0b[l]-2),x1b[l]+3
        for gap in range(1,int(0.4*P)+1):
            if bot2[l]+gap>=H:
                break
            row = lab[bot2[l]+gap,xa:xb]
            hit = [v for v in np.unique(row[row>0]) if v!=l and stem[v] and major[v]>=0]
            if hit:
                n2 = major[hit[0]]
                rows = big&(major==n2)&(np.abs(cx-cx[l])<=1.5*P)
                if rows.any() and 0.25*P<=np.median(cy[rows])-cy[l]<=0.7*P:
                    major[l],tiny[l] = n2, True
                break
    own = np.full((H,W),-1,np.int16)
    own[ys[ok],xs[ok]] = np.where(tiny[pl]|minor[pl,rp],major[pl],rp)[ok]
    ownBeforeEF = own.copy()
    return own,ownBeforeEF,region,area,ys,xs
inventory.comment: _BandOwnership: the first guess at which line owns each piece of ink, the band holding the most of it, with small pieces, cut-off tails and dots pulled to their line

inventory.name: _DotsJoinedAbove
inventory.signature: def _DotsJoinedAbove(own, mask, lab, area, region, centres, L, P, H, W, ys, xs)
inventory.source:
def _DotsJoinedAbove(own,mask,lab,area,region,centres,L,P,H,W,ys,xs):
    raw,nr = LabelComponents(mask)
    pr = raw[ys,xs]
    Ar = np.bincount(pr,minlength=nr+1).astype(float)
    rt,rb,rowLeft,rr,_ = PieceBounds(pr,ys,xs,nr,H,W)
    h0,w0 = rb-rt+1,rr-rowLeft+1
    dotr = (Ar>=0.015*P*P)&(Ar<0.1*P*P)&(np.maximum(h0,w0)<=0.5*P)&(np.maximum(h0,w0)<=2.2*np.maximum(np.minimum(h0,w0),1))
    stemr = (Ar>=0.03*P*P)&~dotr
    for d in np.nonzero(dotr)[0]:
        for gap in range(1,int(0.4*P)+1):
            if rb[d]+gap>=H:
                break
            row = raw[rb[d]+gap,max(0,rowLeft[d]-2):rr[d]+3]
            hit = [v for v in np.unique(row[row>0]) if v!=d and stemr[v]]
            if hit:
                n2 = region[rb[d]+gap,max(0,rowLeft[d]-2)+np.nonzero(row==hit[0])[0][0]]
                dv = pr==d
                ov = own[ys[dv],xs[dv]]
                if (ov>=0).any():
                    n1 = np.bincount(ov[ov>=0],minlength=L).argmax()
                    closedPiece = lab[ys[dv][0],xs[dv][0]]
                    wholeWord = area[closedPiece]>=0.2*P*P   #a word, not a floating dot
                    if n2==n1+1 and not wholeWord and (rt[d]+rb[d])/2>=centres[n1]+0.45*P:
                        keep = ov==n1
                        own[ys[dv][keep],xs[dv][keep]] = n2
                break
    return raw,nr,pr,Ar
inventory.comment: _DotsJoinedAbove: returns a small high-sitting piece, fused to a descender above it by the gap closing, to the line its own stem belongs to

inventory.name: _RingsToStem
inventory.signature: def _RingsToStem(own, raw, nr, pr, Ar, lab, area, region, centres, P, H, W, ys, xs)
inventory.source:
def _RingsToStem(own,raw,nr,pr,Ar,lab,area,region,centres,P,H,W,ys,xs):
    colbot = np.full((nr+1,W),-1,np.int32)
    np.maximum.at(colbot,(pr,xs),ys)
    wr = int(0.35*P)
    for c in range(1,nr+1):
        cols = np.nonzero(colbot[c]>=0)[0]
        if len(cols)==0 or Ar[c]<0.015*P*P:
            continue
        order = cols[np.argsort(-colbot[c][cols])]
        taken = np.zeros(W,bool)
        for xb in order[:60]:
            if taken[xb]:
                continue
            taken[max(0,xb-wr):xb+wr+1] = True
            yb = colbot[c][xb]
            xa,xe = max(0,xb-wr),min(W,xb+wr+1)
            widest,rt = 0, None
            for r in range(yb,max(0,yb-int(0.5*P)),-1):   #walk up while the blob stays wide
                cc = np.nonzero(raw[r,xa:xe]==c)[0]
                wd = (cc.max()-cc.min()+1) if len(cc) else 0
                widest = max(widest,wd)
                if wd<0.45*widest:
                    rt = r
                    break
            else:
                rt = max(0,yb-int(0.5*P))
            h = yb-rt
            if not (0.2*P<=widest<=0.45*P and 0.6<=h/max(widest,1)<=1.6) or yb-rt>=0.5*P:
                continue
            blob = (raw[rt+1:yb+1,xa:xe]==c)
            bc = np.nonzero(blob.any(0))[0]
            xl,xr = xa+bc.min(),xa+bc.max()
            if LabelComponents(~np.pad(blob[:,bc.min():bc.max()+1],1))[1]<2:   #a ring encloses a hole
                continue
            n = region[yb,xb]
            for gap in range(1,int(0.4*P)+1):
                if yb+gap>=H:
                    break
                row = raw[yb+gap,max(0,xl-2):xr+3]
                hit = np.nonzero((row>0)&(row!=c))[0]
                if len(hit):
                    ty,tx = yb+gap,max(0,xl-2)+hit[0]
                    n2 = region[ty,tx]
                    wholeWord = area[lab[yb,xb]]>=0.2*P*P
                    if n2==n+1 and not wholeWord and ty>=centres[n2]-0.45*P:
                        sub = own[rt+1:yb+1,xl:xr+1]
                        sub[blob[:,xl-xa:xr-xa+1]&(sub==n)] = n2
                    break
inventory.comment: ---_RingsToStem: gives a closed ring sitting on a stem to the line that stem belongs to---

inventory.signature: def _FragmentsToNeighbour(own, ownBeforeEF, mask, centres, L, P, H, W)

inventory.name: AssignOwnership
inventory.signature: def AssignOwnership(mask, lab, nc, cuts, cutsArr, L, centres, P, H, W)
inventory.source:
def AssignOwnership(mask,lab,nc,cuts,cutsArr,L,centres,P,H,W):
    own,ownBeforeEF,region,area,ys,xs = _BandOwnership(
        mask,lab,nc,cuts,cutsArr,L,P,H,W,centres)
    raw,nr,pr,Ar = _DotsJoinedAbove(
        own,mask,lab,area,region,centres,L,P,H,W,ys,xs)
    _RingsToStem(own,raw,nr,pr,Ar,lab,area,region,centres,P,H,W,ys,xs)
    _FragmentsToNeighbour(own,ownBeforeEF,mask,centres,L,P,H,W)
    return own
inventory.comment: ---AssignOwnership: the band guess followed by the three corrections, in order---

inventory.name: _BuildLineCrop
inventory.signature: def _BuildLineCrop(n, own, norm, P, f, H, W, minInk)
inventory.source:
def _BuildLineCrop(n,own,norm,P,f,H,W,minInk):
    ink = own==n
    yy,xx = np.nonzero(ink)
    if len(yy)<minInk or yy.max()-yy.min()<max(6,0.2*P):
        return None
    rowInk = np.bincount(yy,minlength=H)>0
    gapAt = np.flatnonzero(~rowInk[yy.min():yy.max()+1])+yy.min()
    if len(gapAt):   #keep the tallest contiguous run of ink, dropping distant marks
        runs,s = [],yy.min()
        for g in gapAt:
            if g>s:
                runs.append((s,g-1))
            s = g+1
        runs.append((s,yy.max()))
        runs = [(a,b) for a,b in runs if b>=a]
        mainRun = max(runs,key=lambda ab: int(ink[ab[0]:ab[1]+1].sum()))
        if mainRun[1]-mainRun[0]+1<yy.max()-yy.min()+1-0.8*P:
            keep = (yy>=mainRun[0])&(yy<=mainRun[1])
            ink = np.zeros_like(ink)
            ink[yy[keep],xx[keep]] = True
            yy,xx = yy[keep],xx[keep]
    pad = int(0.15*P)
    y0,y1 = max(0,yy.min()-pad),min(H,yy.max()+1+pad)
    x0,x1 = max(0,xx.min()-pad),min(W,xx.max()+1+pad)
    Y0,Y1,X0,X1 = int(y0*f),int(y1*f),int(x0*f),int(x1*f)
    inkC = ink[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    #bilinear: the soft edge it gives is what makes the stroke edge natural
    alpha = Resize((inkC*255).astype(np.uint8),X1-X0,Y1-Y0,'linear').astype(np.float32)/255.0
    haloR = max(1,int(0.20*P))
    halo = AnyWithinRadius(AnyWithinRadius(inkC,haloR,0),haloR,1)
    haloAlpha = Resize((halo*255).astype(np.uint8),X1-X0,Y1-Y0,'linear').astype(np.float32)/255.0
    region = norm[Y0:Y1,X0:X1]
    localR = max(3,min(20,round(region.shape[0]/8)))
    localRatio = region/np.maximum(BoxMean(region,localR),1.0)   #this line's own contrast
    localMask = localRatio<Otsu(localRatio)
    ownC = own[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    notOther = ~((ownC>=0)&(ownC!=n))   #never recover a pixel given to a neighbour
    #nearest, not bilinear: this is a yes or no ownership flag
    notOtherFull = Resize((notOther*255).astype(np.uint8),X1-X0,Y1-Y0,'nearest')>127
    alpha = np.maximum(alpha,localMask*haloAlpha*notOtherFull)
    inkPix = region[alpha>0.5]
    black = np.percentile(inkPix,40) if len(inkPix) else 0.0   #typical ink darkness
    white = np.percentile(region,75)

    linear = np.clip((region-black)*(255.0/max(white-black,1.0)),0,255)
    darkness = np.clip((255.0-linear)/255.0,0,1)**0.55   #gamma below one darkens faint strokes
    enhanced = 255.0*(1.0-darkness)
    crop = (alpha*enhanced+(1-alpha)*255).astype(np.uint8)
    margin = int(pad*f)   #the same left gap on every crop
    firstCol = int(np.argmax((alpha>0.1).any(axis=0))) if (alpha>0.1).any() else margin
    shift = firstCol-margin
    if shift>0:
        crop = np.pad(crop[:,shift:],((0,0),(0,shift)),constant_values=255)
    return dict(image=crop,
                clf=FitFixedCanvas(crop,InputHeight,InputWidth),
                bbox=(X0,Y0,X1,Y1))

def LineAxisScore(page):

def SegmentLines(page,mergeValley=None):
    fullA,halfA,mask,ratio,best = Deskew(page)
    g = halfA.astype(np.float64)
    H,W = mask.shape
    mask,paper,P,paperRemoved,removed = RemovePrintedStructure(mask,g)
    mask,lab,nc,area,nArtifacts = DropArtifactPieces(mask,ratio,P,H,W)
    P,centres = LineCentres(mask,H,mergeValley)
    cuts,cutsArr,L = SeamCuts(mask,centres,P,H,W)
    own = AssignOwnership(mask,lab,nc,cuts,cutsArr,L,centres,P,H,W)

    #the crops come off the full-resolution page, though every decision
    #above was taken at half size
    r = max(8,min(40,round(H/41)))
    bgFull = Resize(BoxMean(g,r).astype(np.float32),fullA.shape[1],fullA.shape[0],'linear')
    norm = np.clip(fullA.astype(np.float32)/np.maximum(bgFull,1.0),0,1)*255
    f = fullA.shape[1]/W   #half-size coordinate to full size
    perLine = np.bincount(own[own>=0],minlength=L)
    minInk = max(60,0.12*np.median(perLine[perLine>0]))
    lines = []
    for n in range(L):
        crop = _BuildLineCrop(n,own,norm,P,f,H,W,minInk)
        if crop is None:
            continue
        crop['order'] = len(lines)
        lines.append(crop)
    nBuilt = len(lines)
    lines = DropSolidCrops(lines)
    nDropped = nBuilt-len(lines)

    return lines,dict(cuts=cuts,ratio=ratio,paper=paper),dict(
        angle=float(best),pitch=int(P),
        paperCoverage=round(float(paper.mean()),3),
        inkOutsidePaper=paperRemoved,removedStraightPixels=removed,
        artifactPieces=nArtifacts,nLines=len(lines),dropped=nDropped)

def SimplifyPolyline(poly,eps=0.6):
    if len(poly)<3:
        return poly
    p = np.asarray(poly,np.float64)
    fromStart = np.hypot(*(p-p[0]).T)
    if fromStart[-1]<=max(1.5,0.25*fromStart.max()):
        far = int(np.argmax(fromStart))
        if 0<far<len(poly)-1:
            return SimplifyPolyline(poly[:far+1],eps)[:-1]+ \
                   SimplifyPolyline(poly[far:],eps)
    a,b = p[0],p[-1]
    ab = b-a
    L = np.hypot(*ab)+1e-9
    rel = p-a
    d = np.abs(ab[0]*rel[:,1]-ab[1]*rel[:,0])/L
    i = int(np.argmax(d))
    if d[i]>eps:
        return SimplifyPolyline(poly[:i+1],eps)[:-1]+ \
               SimplifyPolyline(poly[i:],eps)
    return [poly[0],poly[-1]]
inventory.comment: ---SimplifyPolyline: keeps a point only where removing it would move the path by more than eps---

inventory.source:
def ExtractLineGlyphs(gray,text,model):
    rawW = gray.shape[1]
    t = TensorFromResized(ResizeLineImageFixed(gray))
    lp = model.Forward(t)[:,0,:]
    res = CtcForcedAlign(lp,text)
    if res is None:
        return None, None
    align,conf = res
    T = lp.shape[0]

    ink = BinarizeLine(gray)
    band = CoreBand(ink)
    if band is None:
        return None, None
    top,base = band
    xh = float(base-top)
    slant = EstimateSlantDeg(ink)
    shear = np.tan(np.radians(slant))

    #the cut cost per column: thin ink, low down
    colProf = ink.sum(axis=0).astype(np.float64)
    k = max(3,int(round(xh*0.12)))|1
    colSm = np.convolve(colProf,np.ones(k)/k,mode='same')
    rowsIdx = np.arange(ink.shape[0])[:, None]
    hiY = np.where(ink,rowsIdx,ink.shape[0]).min(axis=0).astype(np.float64)
    topAbove = np.clip((base-hiY)/max(1.0,xh),0.0,3.0)   #highest ink per column, above the baseline
    thin = colSm/max(1e-6,float(np.percentile(colSm[colSm>0],60))
                       if (colSm>0).any() else 1.0)

    cutCost = thin+1.15*topAbove
    cutCost[colProf==0] = 0.0   #a true gap is always a free cut
    snapR = max(3,int(round(xh*0.5)))

    #the cheapest column within snapR of x, with a mild pull towards x itself
    def _Snap(x,floor=None):
        a = int(np.clip(round(x)-snapR,0,rawW-1))
        b = int(np.clip(round(x)+snapR+1,1,rawW))
        if b-a<2:
            return float(x)
        win = cutCost[a:b].copy()
        off = np.abs(np.arange(a,b)-x)/max(1.0,snapR)
        return float(a+int(np.argmin(win+0.6*off)))

    #frame index to canvas x to original pixel x
    origH = gray.shape[0]
    charXs = []
    for ch,sp in align:
        if sp is None:
            charXs.append((ch, None, None))
            continue
        x0 = FrameXToPixel(sp[0]/T*INPUT_WIDTH,rawW,origH)
        x1 = FrameXToPixel(sp[1]/T*INPUT_WIDTH,rawW,origH)
        charXs.append((ch,x0,x1))
    valid = [(i,c) for i,c in enumerate(charXs) if c[1] is not None]
    centres = [0.5*(c[1]+c[2]) for _,c in valid]

    #one shared, strictly increasing boundary array, so two neighbouring
    #boundaries cannot land on the same column and leave an empty cell
    nV = len(valid)
    minCell = max(1.0,0.08*xh)
    bnd = [0.0]*(nV+1)
    bnd[0] = max(0.0,centres[0]-(0.5*(centres[1]-centres[0])
                                    if nV>1 else xh))
    bnd[nV] = min(float(rawW),centres[-1]+(0.5*(centres[-1]-centres[-2])
                                              if nV>1 else xh))
    for k2 in range(1,nV):
        s = _Snap(0.5*(centres[k2-1]+centres[k2]),floor=bnd[k2-1])
        lo = bnd[k2-1]+minCell
        hi = max(lo,bnd[nV]-(nV-k2)*minCell)   #leave room for the remaining cells
        bnd[k2] = min(max(s,lo),hi)
    cuts = []
    for k2 in range(nV):
        i,(ch,x0,x1) = valid[k2]
        cuts.append((i,ch,bnd[k2],bnd[k2+1],x0,x1))

    glyphs = [None]*len(charXs)
    inkArea = float(ink.sum())

    #the whole line is thinned once, then the traced centrelines are cut at
    #the boundaries: thinning each column slice separately bakes a spurious
    #spine along the cut
    skelAll = Skeletonize(ink)
    polysAll = TracePolylines(skelAll)
    skelLenTotal = sum(
        float(np.hypot(*(np.diff(np.asarray(p),axis=0).T)).sum())
        for p in polysAll) or 1.0

    bounds = [(int(round(c[2])),int(round(c[3]))) for c in cuts]

    #the component map, kept to find the dots the tracer drops
    compLab,_nComp = LabelComponents(ink)

    segsFor = {i: [] for i in range(len(charXs))}
    crossings = set()
    tracedComps = set()

    #which cut a column belongs to
    def _CellAt(x):
        for k2,(L,R) in enumerate(bounds):
            if L<=x<R:
                return k2
        return None

    #notes the components a path covers, so the dot recovery below does not
    #mistake a traced stroke for an untraced blob
    def _MarkComps(p):
        for pt in p:
            px,py = int(round(pt[0])),int(round(pt[1]))
            if 0<=py<compLab.shape[0] and 0<=px<compLab.shape[1]:
                tracedComps.add(int(compLab[py,px]))

    #the t or f whose crossbar this path is: short, much wider than tall,
    #well above the baseline, and starting in or next to a bar letter's cell
    def _BarOwner(p):
        xs = [q[0] for q in p]
        ys = [q[1] for q in p]
        dx,dy = max(xs)-min(xs), max(ys)-min(ys)
        if dx<BAR_MIN_W*xh or dx>BAR_MAX_W*xh:
            return None
        if dx<BAR_FLATNESS*max(dy,1e-6):
            return None
        if float(np.median([(base-y)/max(1.0,xh) for y in ys]))<BAR_MIN_HEIGHT:
            return None
        k2 = _CellAt(min(xs))
        if k2 is None:
            return None
        if cuts[k2][1] in _BAR_CHARS:
            return k2 if _CellAt(max(xs))!=k2 else None
        #a bar lying wholly inside the following letter's cell still belongs
        #to the t before it
        prev = k2-1
        if prev>=0 and cuts[prev][1] in _BAR_CHARS:
            return prev
        return None

    for p in polysAll:
        owner = _BarOwner(p)
        if owner is not None:
            #the whole bar goes to the letter it belongs to, and no crossing
            #is recorded: a bar over the next letter is not a pen join
            _MarkComps(p)
            segsFor[cuts[owner][0]].append(list(p))
            continue
        cur,curT = [], None
        for pt in p:
            px,py = int(round(pt[0])),int(round(pt[1]))
            if 0<=py<compLab.shape[0] and 0<=px<compLab.shape[1]:
                tracedComps.add(int(compLab[py,px]))
            t = None
            for k2,(L,R) in enumerate(bounds):
                if L<=pt[0]<R:
                    t = cuts[k2][0]
                    break
            if t!=curT:
                if curT is not None and len(cur)>=2:
                    segsFor[curT].append(cur)
                if curT is not None and t is not None:
                    crossings.add((min(curT,t),max(curT,t)))
                cur = [pt] if t is not None else []
                curT = t
            elif t is not None:
                cur.append(pt)
        if curT is not None and len(cur)>=2:
            segsFor[curT].append(cur)

    #a dot thins to a single pixel rather than a polyline, so any component
    #the tracer produced nothing for is recovered as a short dash
    minDotPx = max(2,int(round(DOT_MIN_AREA*xh*xh)))
    for cid in np.unique(compLab):
        if cid==0 or int(cid) in tracedComps:
            continue
        ysC,xsC = np.nonzero(compLab==cid)
        if ysC.size<minDotPx:
            continue
        xc = float(xsC.mean())
        owner = None
        for k2,(L,R) in enumerate(bounds):
            if L<=xc<R:
                owner = cuts[k2][0]
                break
        if owner is None:
            continue
        yc = float(ysC.mean())
        x0c,x1c = float(xsC.min()),float(xsC.max())
        if x1c-x0c<1.0:
            x0c,x1c = x0c-0.5,x1c+0.5
        segsFor[owner].append([(x0c,yc),(x1c,yc)])

    for (i,ch,left,right,ax0,ax1) in cuts:
        if ch==' ':
            glyphs[i] = dict(char=' ',width=(right-left)/xh)
            continue
        polys = [s for s in segsFor[i] if len(s)>=2]
        if not polys:
            glyphs[i] = None
            continue
        #a centreline crossing a boundary means the pen never lifted there
        connL = any(i in pr for pr in crossings if i-1 in pr)
        connR = any(i in pr for pr in crossings if i+1 in pr)

        #origin at the left cut and the baseline, y up, divided by x-height,
        #and de-slanted
        norm = []
        for p in polys:
            p = SimplifyPolyline(p,eps=0.6)
            q = []
            for (x,y) in p:
                yn = (base-y)/xh
                xn = (x-left)/xh
                xn = xn-shear*yn
                q.append((round(xn,3),round(yn,3)))
            norm.append(q)
        #each stroke oriented left to right, then sorted by its start
        norm = [(s if s[0][0]<=s[-1][0] else s[::-1]) for s in norm]
        norm.sort(key=lambda s: min(pt[0] for pt in s))
        norm,entry,exitPt = _TrimLigatureTails(norm,connL=connL,connR=connR)
        if not norm:
            glyphs[i] = None
            continue
        #re-aligned in the re-slanted frame the glyph will be drawn in
        xr = [px+shear*py for s in norm for (px,py) in s]
        x0r,x1r = min(xr),max(xr)
        norm = [[(round(px-x0r,3),py) for (px,py) in s] for s in norm]
        ysAll = [pt[1] for s in norm for pt in s]
        glyphs[i] = dict(
            char=ch,strokes=norm,
            width=round(x1r-x0r,3),
            advance=round((right-left)/xh,3),
            #the gap from the cell's left edge to where the ink starts
            lead=round(float(np.clip(x0r,0.0,1.5)),3),
            top=round(max(ysAll),3),bot=round(min(ysAll),3),
            entryX=round(entry[0]-x0r,3),entryY=round(entry[1],3),
            exitX=round(exitPt[0]-x0r,3),exitY=round(exitPt[1],3),
            connL=connL,connR=connR)

    stats = dict(slant=slant,xh=xh,alignConf=conf,
                 strokeW=inkArea/max(1.0,skelLenTotal),
                 cuts=[(int(i),ch,float(left),float(right))
                       for (i,ch,left,right,_ax0,_ax1) in cuts])
    return glyphs,stats
inventory.comment: ExtractLineGlyphs: one line and its text in, one glyph per character out, the reader gives each character's column span, the boundary snaps to the cheapest nearby column, the whole line is thinned once, and the centrelines are cut at those boundaries and stored upright in x-heights

def _ShapeGrid(g,n=12):
    xs,ys = [],[]
    for st in g['strokes']:
        for (x0,y0),(x1,y1) in zip(st,st[1:]):
            d = max(abs(x1-x0),abs(y1-y0))
            k = max(2,int(d*24))
            for t in np.linspace(0.0,1.0,k):
                xs.append(x0+t*(x1-x0))
                ys.append(y0+t*(y1-y0))
        if len(st)==1:
            xs.append(st[0][0])
            ys.append(st[0][1])
    if not xs:
        return None
    xs = np.asarray(xs)
    ys = np.asarray(ys)
    w = max(1e-3,xs.max()-xs.min())
    h = max(1e-3,ys.max()-ys.min())
    gx = np.clip(((xs-xs.min())/w*(n-1)).astype(int),0,n-1)
    gy = np.clip(((ys-ys.min())/h*(n-1)).astype(int),0,n-1)
    grid = np.zeros((n,n),np.float32)
    np.add.at(grid,(gy,gx),1.0)   #several stroke points can land in one cell
    grid = np.sqrt(grid)   #damp long dwells
    pad = np.pad(grid,1)   #3x3 blur
    grid = sum(pad[a:a+n,b:b+n]*(0.25 if (a==1 and b==1) else 0.09375)
               for a in range(3) for b in range(3))
    v = grid.ravel()
    nrm = float(np.linalg.norm(v))
    return v/nrm if nrm>1e-9 else None
inventory.comment: _ShapeGrid: describes a shape as a normalised 12 by 12 grid of ink counts, blurred a little so two writings of one letter need not line up exactly
